instruction: A compact DJ turntable deck with a carbon-black chassis, exposed ribbon cabling and a magnetically floating platter that hovers a centimeter above the base. Acid-green EL strips outline the pitch fader while a cracked LCD scrolls glitching katakana and a taped-on hazard decal peels at the corner. Scuffed matte panels contrast against chrome bolt heads and hot-pink underglow.
